description: Controlled malicious-client attacks against plain sample-weighted FedAvg (no defense). Declared before any run; not tuned on validation or test results.

threat_model.attacker_selection: seeded uniform draw over the 5 clients: numpy default_rng([seed, selection_seed_offset]).integers(5); recorded per run
threat_model.persistence: same compromised client in every round; full participation, so exactly one malicious update per round
threat_model.knowledge: broadcast global model and its own honest update only; no collusion, no access to other clients' updates
threat_model.capability: replaces its transmitted state with w_t + Delta' over all floating-point entries; integer BatchNorm counters unchanged; reports its true sample count
threat_model.server: unmodified sample-weighted FedAvg; no update validation, clipping, or robust aggregation

random_noise.description: Delta' = ||Delta|| * z / ||z||, z ~ N(0, I) seeded per seed and round

comparator.description: Clean FedAvg: Day 11 natural-partition runs with the same seeds (bit-identical to the Day 16 recorded runs)
